setup: CREATE TABLE base (id integer, name text, some_date timestamp without time zone)

cases.sql:
create  table "{{schema}}"."utils__dbt_tmp"
  
  
    as
  
  (
    
                select id, md5(cast(coalesce(cast(id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(name as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as sk,
                
    ( id ) / nullif( ( id ), 0)
 as ratio
                from "{{schema}}"."base"
  );

create view "{{schema}}"."unioned__dbt_tmp"
    
    
  as (
    
                
    

        (
            select
                cast('"{{schema}}"."base"' as TEXT) as _dbt_source_relation,

                
                    cast("id" as integer) as "id" ,
                    cast("name" as text) as "name" ,
                    cast("some_date" as timestamp without time zone) as "some_date" ,
                    cast(null as text) as "sk" ,
                    cast(null as integer) as "ratio" 

            from "{{schema}}"."base"

            
        )

        union all
        

        (
            select
                cast('"{{schema}}"."utils"' as TEXT) as _dbt_source_relation,

                
                    cast("id" as integer) as "id" ,
                    cast(null as text) as "name" ,
                    cast(null as timestamp without time zone) as "some_date" ,
                    cast("sk" as text) as "sk" ,
                    cast("ratio" as integer) as "ratio" 

            from "{{schema}}"."utils"

            
        )

        
  );
